title: Comprehensive Cyber Security Framework for Primary (Urban) Cooperative Banks (UCBs) – A Graded Approach
description: Withdrawn-list row 36 states: "DoS.CO/CSITE/BC.4083/31.01.052/2019-20 — Comprehensive Cyber Security Framework for Primary (Urban) Cooperative Banks (UCBs) - A Graded Approach — December 31, 2019". Paragraph 180 of the stored UCB Direction state that repeal was communicated by circular DoS.CO.PPG.66/11.01.005/2026-27 dated July 31, 2026. Which 2026 Direction succeeds it is this project's reading of the two texts, not a statement by RBI.
